title: The Horse Book
setting: A small bookstore and a home dining room.

characters.name: Sara
characters.look: Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt)

characters.name: Kofi
characters.look: Kofi (a man of about thirty with dark skin, a shaved head, a short black beard and a light-blue shirt)

sentences.en: Sara and Kofi visit a small bookstore.
sentences.zh: 萨拉和科菲去逛一家小书店。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt) and Kofi (a man of about thirty with dark skin, a shaved head, a short black beard and a light-blue shirt) walk into a small cosy bookstore.

sentences.en: They see many young people reading there.
sentences.zh: 他们看到那里有很多年轻人在看书。
sentences.scene_prompt: Many young people read books between the shelves while Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt) and Kofi (a man of about thirty with dark skin, a shaved head, a short black beard and a light-blue shirt) look around.

sentences.en: Sara needs a book with horse photos.
sentences.zh: 萨拉需要一本有马的照片的书。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt) holds a book with a photo of a horse on its cover.

sentences.en: She read it at the library a week ago.
sentences.zh: 一个星期前她在图书馆读过这本书。
sentences.scene_prompt: In the bookstore, Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt) holds up the horse book and points through the window at a library building across the street, Kofi (a man of about thirty with dark skin, a shaved head, a short black beard and a light-blue shirt) listening.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Sara with the horse book pointing at the library; reading it there a week ago can't be shown.

sentences.en: Soon they are hungry, so they walk away.
sentences.zh: 很快他们饿了，于是就走了。
sentences.scene_prompt: Kofi (a man of about thirty with dark skin, a shaved head, a short black beard and a light-blue shirt) rubs his stomach as he and Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt) walk away from the bookstore.

sentences.en: At home, Kofi cooks fish for dinner.
sentences.zh: 回到家，科菲做鱼当晚饭。
sentences.scene_prompt: Kofi (a man of about thirty with dark skin, a shaved head, a short black beard and a light-blue shirt) cooks fish in a pan in a home kitchen.

sentences.en: Sara puts a light over the dining-room table.
sentences.zh: 萨拉在餐厅的桌子上方挂了一盏灯。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt) hangs a lamp over a table in a dining room.

sentences.en: Then she puts a bowl of oranges on it.
sentences.zh: 然后她在上面放了一碗橙子。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt) puts a bowl of oranges on the dining room table under the lamp.
